workspace-canonical
workspace-private unknown
workspace-private partial

# A released lock never makes an uncommitted file or unknown entry authoritative.
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown
stderr 'workspace|journal|unknown'
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace partial
stderr 'workspace|journal|partial|staging'
! stdout .

# Resume cannot change any frozen input or placement through explicit flags.
! skygo run task.yaml --resume-workspace unknown
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown -f task.yaml
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown --env TOKEN=other
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown --output other
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown --target other
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown --request-id other
stderr .
! stdout .
! skygo run --resume-workspace unknown --workdir-ref=
stderr .
! stdout .
workspace-requests 0
